scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.setup:env: npm --prefix server run setup:env && node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('client/.env')){fs.copyFileSync('client/.env.example','client/.env');console.log('Created client/.env')}else{console.log('client/.env already exists')}"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
